findings.issue: תִּתְּנוֹ is qal imperfect 2nd masculine singular with a 3ms object suffix (you will give it). Spanish darán is plural (ustedes or ellos), changing number and, read as ellos, person and participant. The same 2ms addressee is already harás.

notes: Así harás, a tu buey, a tu rebaño, siete días, será con su madre, en el día el octavo, and a mí match the remaining tokens.
